meta.parties: Peris Et Al. v. Perera Et Al

rules.statement: The Court should not regard a partition suit as one to be decided merely on issues raised by and between the parties, and it ought not to make a decree unless it is perfectly satisfied that the persons in whose favour the decree is asked for are entitled to the property sought to be partitioned.
